answer: In PoA, each agent identity is bound to an enclave’s remotely attested MRENCLAVE, which commits to its measured code; hardware-backed platform evidence verifies execution on genuine silicon. Because MRENCLAVE alone is not a unique device ID, registration must also enforce platform credentials and prevent key reuse. This makes creating Sybil identities require additional attested hardware, not simply cloning virtual machines—a vine of copies cannot extend the wharf beyond the hardware horizon.
